verdict.rationale: Belvo is API-first. Its published OpenAPI spec spans aggregation, fiscal (Mexico and Chile), enrichment, employment and payments resources, and it adds webhooks, Postman collections and MCP servers. However, nothing documents that every UI or dashboard capability (e.g. the no-code solution or Connect Widget customization) has an API equivalent. The spec is also not served at standard machine-readable OpenAPI paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that dashboard and no-code operations are exposed via the API, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI file, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
